title: MCP protocol, account connections and native Antigravity plugin
summary: Business tool behavior is canonical in its domain. This area documents authentication, browser-only credential management, OAuth, activity privacy, proxy onboarding and native plugin interaction. Real managed provider/shared deployment remains pending. Related test paths are references, not proof of per-case execution.
